description: This file defines a PHP class `SaleOrder` within the namespace `Opencart\Admin\Controller\Extension\Opencart\Report`. The class is a controller component for handling sale order reports in the OpenCart admin system, including methods for displaying the report, saving report settings, and retrieving report data. The code includes logic for processing request parameters, fetching data from models, and rendering views for the report interface.

classes.name: SaleOrder
classes.description: Controller class for managing sale order reports in OpenCart's admin extension. It provides methods to display, save settings, and generate the report data for sale orders.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Initializes the report page, loads language strings, sets breadcrumbs, and renders the sale order report form view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the report configuration settings via POST request, with permission check and JSON response.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Loads report data, order statuses, and other necessary information, then renders the report view.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Processes filter parameters, fetches report order data from model, and returns the report list as a string (HTML).

methods.name: list
methods.description: Outputs a list of reports by calling `getReport()`.
